relations: Melting of the central red mass drives surrounding red and yellow-green liquid pools to creep outward and blend.
Deformation of the red mass into a rounder blob causes the white strips to enclose a smaller center.
Fixed wooden stick and upper-left splash anchor the scene while liquid spreads locally across the surface.
A brief blur precedes the return to sharp focus as the steady melting and spreading continue.
caption: The video showcases a melting red popsicle bar lying diagonally on a plain white surface, its flat wooden stick pointing toward the lower right. The glossy red mass is partly submerged in spreading pools of red and yellow-green liquid, with several white curved topping strips resting across the top. Over time, the liquid pools creep outward and the boundary between the two colors becomes more blended and streaked. The central red mass slowly deforms, rounding from an elongated shape into a more compact blob. Consequently, the white strips come to enclose a smaller, rounder red center. A brief blur appears before the image returns to sharp. The wooden stick and the overall layout of the strips and the upper-left splash remain fixed, indicating local spreading and deformation rather than translation of the whole object. The melt continues steadily, with the process still underway at the end.
